# Metcalf Search
> Fractional recruiting for small and mid-sized businesses, built around the STACK Method (Source, Tempo, Assess, Close, Keep). Flat monthly subscription, no per-hire fees, one recruiter as your single point of contact. Based in Grove City, Ohio, serving Columbus and Central Ohio.
Metcalf Search is a fractional recruiting firm run by Jay Metcalf (27 years in recruiting, more than $100 million in salary placed). It serves small and mid-sized businesses, typically 10 to 200 employees making a few hires a year, across skilled trades, light manufacturing, distribution, and professional services. It sits between contingency agencies and full-time internal recruiters as a third option: an embedded recruiting function on a flat monthly subscription. Three tiers: Recruiting Partner ($2,950 a month, one active role at a time), Recruiting Partner Plus ($5,950 a month, two to three concurrent roles and up to 8 hours onsite a month time), Recruiting Partner Pro ($10,950 a month, full embedded recruiting across the company). Month to month, no per-hire fees. Our work is organized around the STACK Method, a five-letter diagnostic that maps every hiring problem to one of five places: Source, Tempo, Assess, Close, or Keep (Keep means the hire sticking: onboarding and the first year).

- [Recruiting Partner Plus](https://metcalfsearch.com/recruiting-partner-plus): $5,950 a month. Two to three roles at once and a weekly hiring huddle and up to 8 hours onsite a month, for hiring that does not stop
- [Recruiting Partner Pro](https://metcalfsearch.com/recruiting-partner-pro): $10,950 a month. A dedicated recruiter onsite three days a week on every open role, no cap, for companies hiring constantly

## Method
- [The STACK Method overview](https://metcalfsearch.com/stack-method): The five letters and where each hiring problem lives
- [SOURCE: attracting candidates](https://metcalfsearch.com/source): How small businesses compete for talent
- [TEMPO: keeping candidates warm](https://metcalfsearch.com/tempo): Process rhythm, ghosting, response time
- [ASSESS: vetting candidates](https://metcalfsearch.com/assess): Structured interviews, scorecards, skill assessment
- [CLOSE: making offers stick](https://metcalfsearch.com/close): Counter-offers, offer acceptance, late-stage drops
- [KEEP: retaining new hires](https://metcalfsearch.com/keep): Onboarding, the first ninety days, stay interviews
